Package net.tnemc.item.paper.platform.impl.modern

Class PaperMapColorComponent

java.lang.Object
net.tnemc.item.component.impl.MapColorComponent<net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack,org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>
net.tnemc.item.paper.platform.impl.modern.PaperMapColorComponent
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.tnemc.item.component.SerialComponent<net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack,org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>, net.tnemc.item.platform.applier.ItemApplicator<net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack,org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>, net.tnemc.item.platform.check.ItemCheck<org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>, net.tnemc.item.platform.Identifiable, net.tnemc.item.platform.serialize.ItemSerializer<net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack,org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>
public class PaperMapColorComponent extends net.tnemc.item.component.impl.MapColorComponent<net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack,org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>
Replaces TNIL's map color component, which references DataComponentTypes.MAP_COLOR.

Paper 26.3 removed that data component, so the component disables itself when the field is missing instead of throwing NoSuchFieldError on every item serialization.
